description:
Just like a combat engineer, when there’s a problem, you make it your mission to fix it. Proudly exhibit your industrial prowess and craftmanship with our Military Grade Workwear Bottle Cap T-Shirt. These iron-willed tees are great for tradesmen, industry workers, mechanics, carpenters, or anyone that turns a wrench.

 

Reliable and Long-Lasting:

  • Go ahead and wear your graphic without a worry! The durable 60% Cotton / 40% Polyester blend easily withstands a hard day’s work.

 

For the Rough and Tough:

  • These rugged workwear style shirts feature reinforced seams at the collar and sleeves that enhance the shirt’s durability, and with a tag-less neck label, you’re free to move around without any itches or scratches.

 

Good Ol’ American Ingenuity:

  • These graphic t-shirts are inspired by the tenacity and creativity of the American spirit. The main design is across the back, with a shield and crossed wrenches on the left chest, and the American Flag on the right sleeve.

 

Fits Like a Glove:

  • These reliable t-shirts are standard fit, giving you the perfect amount of room and flexibility for any activity. Their length should go past the waist, providing you with additional coverage.
